description: Life Cycle Inventory of Dhaka City Municipal Solid Waste Management System is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Shaik Mohammed Joarder (University of Nevada, Reno). The dataset provide Life Cycle Inventory (LCI) of Dhaka City Municipal Solid Waste Management System. The inventory is formed by combining World Bank Report, Waste Report from Dhaka City Corporations, JICA Waste Database, and ecoinvent database. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: Excel, PDF. Size stated: 642198. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
